tasks.spec:
You are an implementation worker. Write exactly ONE Python file in your current working directory: ./voice_master_lab.py. READ access to /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast; never write to it. No git, no MCP, no network.

CONTEXT. A podcast's spoken voices sound MUFFLED next to its crisp outro music. Measured: voice spectral centroid ~1120Hz and high-band(6-16k)-minus-lowmid(250-2k) of -41.7dB, versus the outro target of ~2342Hz and -24.8dB. An EQ-only chain (highpass 85, -4dB @300Hz, +11dB highshelf@3200, +6dB@9000, de-ess notch, limiter) only reached 1798Hz. The owner picked that chain's character ("medium": crisp not tinny) but wants MORE crispness toward the outro, and correctly says EQ alone is not enough. The additional levers, in the order of expected impact:
1. HARMONIC EXCITEMENT (ffmpeg aexciter): synthesizes NEW upper harmonics; EQ can only boost what a dull capture contains. This is the classic fix for a muffled voice.
2. NOISE-FLOOR REDUCTION (afftdn, gentle, e.g. nr=10-12 nf=-30): room tone masks consonant detail; removing it raises perceived clarity. GENTLE only; aggressive denoise = underwater artifacts.
3. FAST-ATTACK COMPRESSION (acompressor: ratio ~3:1, attack 5-10ms, release 100-200ms, makeup): evens the voice and sharpens transients.
4. AIR SHELF (+3-4dB @ 12kHz) after excitement.
5. De-ess notch (~6.8kHz) AFTER brightening, and alimiter=0.95 last. Loudness-normalize each rendered variant to the same integrated LUFS (two-pass loudnorm to -16) so the comparison is level-matched and only timbre differs.

FILE CONTRACT: ./voice_master_lab.py, argparse CLI:
  voice_master_lab.py --stem PATH --out DIR --label NAME [--spans "a-b,c-d"] [--target-centroid 2342] [--target-hilomid -24.8] [--json OUT]
It must:
(a) Extract the given spans (or a default 10s) from the stem into a working WAV.
(b) Render FIVE variants, each a named constant CHAIN_* string: V0_original (no processing), V1_eq_medium (exactly the owner-picked chain above), V2_eq_excite (V1 plus aexciter with moderate settings, e.g. amount=2-3, drive on the 3-9kHz region), V3_full (V2 plus gentle afftdn FIRST in chain, plus acompressor before EQ), V4_full_air (V3 plus +3.5dB shelf @12kHz). Loudness-match all five to -16 LUFS integrated (two-pass) so level does not bias the ear test.
(c) MEASURE each variant: spectral centroid, high-band minus lowmid (same band defs as above), integrated LUFS; print a table with the target row; write --json if given.
(d) Concatenate the five variants back to back with 0.4s silence gaps into <out>/<label>_variants.mp3 (160k), announced order V0..V4, and print the file path.
Fail loudly (exit 2) on missing stem/ffmpeg. No hard-coded episode names or absolute episode paths inside the script; everything comes from CLI args.
